tspan.tspan: Note:
When editing this source .odg, you can hide the
dimension lines (print the hole locations only) by right-
clicking the layer “Dimension Lines”, modify layer, and
uncheck "visible" and/or "printable."
(You can hide this hint by doing the same to the “Hint” layer)
Instructions:
Print & cut the paper template along the
dashed line (leave
the line visible to aid aligning &
centering on the 4x8" plastic sheet). This line is halfway between the edge of the plastic (the solid outer
line) & the center of the drilled hole. It will be tape down if cut back this far. If you cut the paper along the
solid line, it would cover plastic to the edge. (It's better for the tape to adhere to some of the
front
plastic
surface before it wraps around to the back. If the paper extends to the edge, the tape would secure only to
the back. That would let the paper shift a little)
Printing:
Printers often have a default "scale to fit" setting. Be sure the printer is set to 100%. Use a ruler to
check the actual printed dimensions.
The .svg image of this template is drawn exactly to size. It may print ok. But, the .pdf version of this
template should be the first choice (the pdf format was created for "printable documents.").
For other formats:
mcacc-collars.charity/resources/leash-sleeve/
This template is used to mark snap-hole locations on an
"adopt me" leash sleeve made for homeless dogs. For
more information visit the link above.
